Package frc.robot.subsystems.turret

Class TurretIODisabled

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.subsystems.turret.TurretIODisabled
All Implemented Interfaces:
TurretIO
public class TurretIODisabled extends Object implements TurretIO
No-op implementation of TurretIO used when the turret is physically absent or intentionally disabled (e.g., a robot build that doesn't have a turret installed yet, or integration tests where turret motion would interfere).

All methods are empty â€” no CAN traffic is generated, and inputs are never updated. The Turret subsystem will continue to function at the software level (commands will schedule and complete) but the physical turret will not move and TurretIOInputs.motorConnected will remain false.

Select this implementation in RobotContainer when the turret is not installed rather than guarding every turret call site with a null check.
